responseBody.subject: Payment Action Required: Transaction of ₹14,500.00 unsuccessful
responseBody.messageBody:
Dear Rajesh Sharma,

We were unable to complete your recent payment of ₹14,500.00 due to an authentication failure with your financial institution.

To resolve this and ensure your service remains uninterrupted, please log in to your official PayBack AI account portal to review your payment details and retry the transaction.

If you believe this is an error or need assistance, please contact our customer support.

Sincerely,
PayBack AI Team
responseBody.complianceNotice: PayBack AI will never ask for your confidential passwords, OTPs, or full credit card numbers via email. Please perform all financial actions through your secure account portal.
